card.name: Digits inside ISBN and dose numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits partway through long numbers, mostly inside ISBN codes in book citations. Also fires on digits within dose ranges or decimals in dosing tables.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a hyphenated ISBN number in a book or audiobook citation.

modes.label: Digits in dose figures
modes.description: A digit inside a decimal or range of dose numbers before mg/kg or in a table.
